scanNote:
GRAMMAR REFERENCE, 2-BET (117-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Grammar Reference'.

CHAP USTUN:
'PRESENT CONTINUOUS (to be + verb -ing)'. TO'Q SARIQ JADVAL: Affirmative: I'm playing, you're playing, he's playing, she's playing, it's playing, we're playing, you're playing, they're playing. Interrogative: Am I playing? Are you playing? Is he playing? Is she playing? Is it playing? Are we playing? Are you playing? Are they playing? Negative: I'm not playing, you aren't playing, he isn't playing, she isn't playing, it isn't playing, we aren't playing, you aren't playing, they aren't playing.
'Form': We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
'Use': • We use the present continuous for: actions happening now, at the moment of speaking. 'I'm playing tennis now.' • actions happening around the time of speaking. 'We're looking for a flat at the moment.' • fixed arrangements in the near future. 'I'm seeing John tomorrow.'
OCh SARIQ QUTI: 'Time expressions used with the present continuous: now, at the moment, at present.'
'Short Answers' (quti): Are you ...? → Yes, I am./Yes, we are. No, I'm not./No, we aren't. Is he/she/it ...? → Yes, he/she/it is. No, he/she/it isn't. Are they ...? → Yes, they are. No, they aren't. 'In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and the verb "to be" in the correct form. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.'

O'NG USTUN:
Ko'k 'UNIT 2'. 'ADVERBS OF FREQUENCY': 'Adverbs of frequency, always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually come before the main verb, but after the auxiliary verb (do, does etc) and the verb to be. They tell us how often something happens.' 'I never get up early on Sundays. He rarely goes to the zoo. (= not often) She sometimes has a sandwich for lunch. Do you often walk to work? Mum is usually home by four. He is always late for work.'
'PAST SIMPLE'. 'Past Simple: regular verbs'. KO'K JADVAL: Affirmative: I worked, you worked, he worked, she worked, it worked, we worked, you worked, they worked. Interrogative: Did I work? Did you work? ... Did they work? Negative: I didn't work, you didn't work, ... they didn't work.
'Form': • We form the affirmative of most regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. 'I work - I worked' • Other verbs have irregular affirmative forms. 'I see - I saw' (see list of irregular verbs on p. 128) • We form the negative of past simple with didn't + base form of the verb. 'I didn't work yesterday, I didn't see Tom yesterday.' • We form the interrogative of past simple with Did + personal subject pronoun + base form of the verb. 'Did he work yesterday? Did you see Tom yesterday?' • We form positive short answers with did and negative short answers with didn't. 'Did you call me? Yes, I did. Did he tell you? No, he didn't.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '117'.

exercises.instructionEn: Present Continuous (to be + verb -ing). Affirmative: I'm playing, he's playing. Interrogative: Am I playing? Is he playing? Negative: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
exercises.instructionUz: Hozirgi davomli zamon (to be + fe'l -ing). Tasdiq: I'm playing, he's playing. So'roq: Am I playing? Is he playing? Inkor: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. Hozirgi davomli zamonni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning asosiy shakliga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS - ShAKLI.

  BE (am/is/are) + FE'L-ING


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TASDIQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I'm playing
  you're / we're / they're playing
  he's / she's / it's playing


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO'ROQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Am I playing?
  Are you / we / they playing?
  Is he / she / it playing?

  ⚠ 'be' oldinga chiqadi.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I'm not playing
  you aren't / we aren't playing
  he isn't / she isn't playing


⚠ 'THE BASE FORM':

  = fe'lning asosiy shakli (play,
  go).

points.en: Affirmative: I'm playing, you're playing, he's/she's/it's playing, we're/they're playing.
points.uz: Tasdiq: I'm playing, you're playing, he's/she's/it's playing, we're/they're playing.

points.en: Interrogative: Am I playing? Are you playing? Is he/she/it playing? Are we/they playing?
points.uz: So'roq: Am I playing? Are you playing? Is he/she/it playing? Are we/they playing?

points.en: Negative: I'm not playing, you aren't playing, he/she/it isn't playing, we/they aren't playing.
points.uz: Inkor: I'm not playing, you aren't playing, he/she/it isn't playing, we/they aren't playing.

points.en: We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
points.uz: Hozirgi davomli zamonni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning asosiy shakliga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Use. Time expressions: now, at the moment, at present. Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi. Vaqt iboralari: now, at the moment, at present. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS - IShLATILIShI:

  1 HOZIR, gapirish paytida
    bo'layotgan ish:
    "I'm playing tennis NOW."
  2 Gapirish vaqti ATROFIDA
    bo'layotgan ish (aynan hozir
    emas):
    "We're looking for a flat at the
     moment."
  3 YAQIN KELAJAKDAGI ANIQ REJA:
    "I'm seeing John tomorrow."


VAQT IBORALARI:
  now = hozir
  at the moment = ayni paytda
  at present = hozirda


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Are you ...? → Yes, I am. / No,
    I'm not.
  Is he ...? → Yes, he is. / No, he
    isn't.
  Are they ...? → Yes, they are. /
    No, they aren't.

  ⚠ -ING fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'Yes,
  I am' ('Yes, I am playing' EMAS).
  ⚠ 'Yes, I'm' - XATO! Qisqa
  ijobiy javobda qisqartma yo'q.


⚠ 'A FIXED ARRANGEMENT':

  = aniq kelishilgan reja.


⚠ 'A FLAT':

  = kvartira (BrE).

points.en: Actions happening now, at the moment of speaking. I'm playing tennis now.
points.uz: Hozir, gapirish paytida bo'layotgan ishlar. Men hozir tennis o'ynayapman.

points.en: Actions happening around the time of speaking. We're looking for a flat at the moment.
points.uz: Gapirish vaqti atrofida bo'layotgan ishlar. Biz ayni paytda kvartira qidiryapmiz.

points.en: Fixed arrangements in the near future. I'm seeing John tomorrow.
points.uz: Yaqin kelajakdagi aniq rejalar. Men ertaga John bilan uchrashaman.

points.en: In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and the verb "to be" in the correct form. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.
points.uz: Qisqa javoblarda 'Yes' yoki 'No', ega olmoshi va 'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shaklini ishlatamiz. -ing li asosiy fe'lni takrorlamaymiz.

sections.title: Unit 2 - Adverbs of Frequency; Past Simple

exercises.instructionEn: Adverbs of frequency, always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually come before the main verb, but after the auxiliary verb (do, does etc) and the verb to be. They tell us how often something happens.
exercises.instructionUz: Takrorlanish ravishlari - always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually - asosiy fe'ldan oldin, lekin yordamchi fe'l (do, does va h.k.) va 'to be' fe'lidan keyin keladi. Ular biror narsa qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishini bildiradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI:

  always = har doim (100%)
  usually = odatda
  often = tez-tez
  sometimes = ba'zan
  rarely = kamdan-kam (= not often)
  never = hech qachon (0%)


O'RNI:

  1 ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
    'I NEVER get up early.'
    'He RARELY goes to the zoo.'
    'She SOMETIMES has a sandwich.'
  2 YoRDAMChI FE'LDAN KEYIN:
    'Do you OFTEN walk to work?'
  3 'BE' DAN KEYIN:
    'Mum IS USUALLY home by four.'
    'He IS ALWAYS late for work.'

  ⚠ 'He always is late' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'never' bilan inkor
  ishlatilmaydi: "I don't never" ✗.


⚠ 'AN AUXILIARY VERB':

  = yordamchi fe'l (do, does, did,
  have, will ...).

points.en: Adverbs of frequency come before the main verb: I never get up early on Sundays. He rarely goes to the zoo. (= not often) She sometimes has a sandwich for lunch.
points.uz: Takrorlanish ravishlari asosiy fe'ldan oldin keladi: Men yakshanba kunlari hech qachon erta turmayman. U kamdan-kam hayvonot bog'iga boradi. U ba'zan tushlikka sendvich yeydi.

points.en: But after the auxiliary verb: Do you often walk to work?
points.uz: Lekin yordamchi fe'ldan keyin: Siz tez-tez ishga piyoda borasizmi?

points.en: And after the verb to be: Mum is usually home by four. He is always late for work.
points.uz: Va 'to be' fe'lidan keyin: Onam odatda to'rtgacha uyda bo'ladi. U har doim ishga kech qoladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Past Simple: regular verbs. Affirmative: I worked. Interrogative: Did I work? Negative: I didn't work.
exercises.instructionUz: O'tgan oddiy zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar. Tasdiq: I worked. So'roq: Did I work? Inkor: I didn't work.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE - ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TASDIQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  To'g'ri fe'llar: FE'L + -ED
    work → worked (HAMMA shaxsda
    bir xil!)
  Noto'g'ri fe'llar: 2-shakl
    see → saw, go → went
    (ro'yxat 128-betda)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DIDN'T + ASOSIY ShAKL
  'I didn't WORK yesterday.'
  'I didn't SEE Tom.' ('didn't saw'
   EMAS!)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO'ROQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DID + EGA + ASOSIY ShAKL
  'Did he WORK yesterday?'
  'Did you SEE Tom?' ('Did you saw'
   EMAS!)


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Did you call me? → Yes, I DID.
  Did he tell you? → No, he DIDN'T.


⚠ 'REGULAR' / 'IRREGULAR':

  = to'g'ri / noto'g'ri (fe'l).

points.en: We form the affirmative of most regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. I work - I worked. Other verbs have irregular affirmative forms. I see - I saw (see list of irregular verbs on p. 128)
points.uz: Ko'p to'g'ri fe'llarning tasdiq shaklini fe'lga -ed qo'shib yasaymiz. I work - I worked. Boshqa fe'llar noto'g'ri tasdiq shakliga ega. I see - I saw (noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati 128-betda)

points.en: We form the negative of past simple with didn't + base form of the verb. I didn't work yesterday, I didn't see Tom yesterday.
points.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamon inkorini didn't + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. Kecha ishlamadim, kecha Tomni ko'rmadim.

points.en: We form the interrogative of past simple with Did + personal subject pronoun + base form of the verb. Did he work yesterday? Did you see Tom yesterday?
points.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamon so'rog'ini Did + ega olmoshi + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. U kecha ishladimi? Kecha Tomni ko'rdingizmi?

points.en: We form positive short answers with did and negative short answers with didn't. Did you call me? Yes, I did. Did he tell you? No, he didn't.
points.uz: Ijobiy qisqa javoblarni did, inkor qisqa javoblarni didn't bilan yasaymiz. Menga qo'ng'iroq qildingmi? Ha. U senga aytdimi? Yo'q.

patterns.formula: EGA + RAVISh + FE'L. / EGA + be + RAVISh.
patterns.exampleEn: I never get up early. He is always late.
patterns.exampleUz: Men hech qachon erta turmayman. U har doim kech qoladi.

patterns.formula: EGA + FE'L-ED / didn't + FE'L. Did + EGA + FE'L?
patterns.exampleEn: I worked yesterday. I didn't see Tom. Did you call me?
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha ishladim. Tomni ko'rmadim. Menga qo'ng'iroq qildingmi?
